conviction_note: Company-confirmed date (6 Oct bmo, press release 15 Sep) and a 5-quarter-ish history of 12.7% median moves; the only unpriced-looking facts are a consensus EPS ($0.63) that sits well below the prior-year $0.98 after a Q1 that beat by $0.14 and was bought +15%, offset by a revenue bar slightly above management's own 'slightly lower' guide and weak ABI, so p_up is only 53 on a 12% absolute move.
bar: Consensus Q2 FY27 adj EPS $0.63, revenue $359.5M (MarketBeat/Defense World 2026-09-29, same underlying feed, https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/upcoming-apogee-enterprises-apog-set-to-release-quarterly-earnings-on-tuesday-2026-09-29/); company Q2 guide: net sales slightly lower and adj EPS lower YoY (Q2 FY26: $358.2M, $0.98). Bar is one estimate feed, so findings are held small. print_vs_bar is on EPS.
positioning_check: Short interest about 3.1-4.2% of float, days to cover 2.5-3.4 (Finviz via search, mid-Sept 2026; Benzinga 4.91% on 2026-09-11) - not crowded. Option chain unusable (no two-sided ATM quotes), so no skew. Stock -5.9% over 20d, -27.7% from 52w high.

findings.finding: Consensus Q2 EPS of $0.63 is 36% below last year's $0.98 while management only guided Q2 adj EPS 'lower' YoY (sales 'slightly lower'), with pricing and surcharges implemented in Q1 to flow through later, and Q1 beat consensus by $0.14 ($0.57 vs $0.43) and the stock rose 15.2%; the bar looks conservative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Baseline: Jun-2026 +15.16%, Apr-2026 +7.59% (beats bought); but Oct-2025 -4.44% on a $0.12 beat and Jan-2026 -13.89%, so reaction is driven by the forward guide.
findings.why_not_priced: If priced, the stock would not be 5.9% down over 20 days into a print with a low bar; the bar is a single feed and 4 analysts cover the name, but the guide is vague ('lower'), so the miss/beat distance is not known.
findings.independence: Consensus figures from https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/upcoming-apogee-enterprises-apog-set-to-release-quarterly-earnings-on-tuesday-2026-09-29/; Q2 FY26 base from https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6845/000000684525000154/a83025fy26q2results.htm. Different documents, same fact family.

findings.finding: Revenue consensus of $359.5M is above the prior-year $358.2M, while management guided Q2 net sales 'slightly lower' and Kalwall (closed 1 Jul, about $85M annual revenue) adds only a few days of contribution to the fiscal Q2 ending late Aug; glass sales fell 7.6% in Q1 and ABI was 47.2 in August.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Baseline gives no revenue-specific reaction; Q1 revenue beat ($342.7M vs $333.8M) coincided with +15.2%.
findings.why_not_priced: Small mismatch (about 0.4% to 2%) between the company's guided direction and consensus; revenue backlog in Architectural Services is $734.5M vs $682.9M a year earlier, which partly offsets.
findings.independence: AIA ABI August 2026: https://www.aia.org/resource-center/abi-august-2026-architecture-firm-billings-continue-decline. A broad series pointing the same way; sized small as a proxy.

findings.finding: Peer Tecnoglass reported record Q2 revenue +15.6% but EBITDA margin down to 17.5% from 31.2% on about $17M of Section 232 aluminum tariff costs and sustained high aluminum costs, indicating input-cost pressure on the group's window and metals products that can delay Apogee's price-cost recovery.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Jan-2026 -13.89% and Jan-2025 -19.02% were prints where the forward guide disappointed; Q1 FY27 held the guide ($2.70-3.25) and was bought.
findings.why_not_priced: Peer read-through, not confirmed by Apogee; Apogee's own Q1 commentary already flagged volatile metals costs and surcharges, so it is largely known.
findings.independence: Apogee Q1 call (https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/06/26/apogee-apog-q1-2027-earnings-call-transcript/) says the same about aluminum costs; this is partly the same fact.

searched_and_found_nothing: 8-K/EDGAR for financing or covenant changes after the Kalwall close (only the 1 Jul closing release found; no financing details)
Short interest on a primary source (only Finviz/Benzinga snippets)
Option-implied move (no two-sided chain in baseline)
Customer or distributor read-throughs after 26 Jun for Apogee specifically
Pre-announcement or guidance change since the Q1 print (none found; Argus target cut to $36 on 2026-09-02, reason not found)

rejected_candidates.candidate: Zacks downgrade from strong-buy to hold on 2026-08-31 and Weiss/Wall Street Zen rating changes
rejected_candidates.detail: Estimate-revision and rating information is the same market sentiment already carried by the stock's 20-day weakness and consensus; folded into the bar finding.

baseline_tension: No skew is available; a modest long lean agrees with the stock being down 5.9% over 20 days and cuts mildly against the weak ABI and the Argus target cut, so p_up is held at 53.
lessons_applied: Lesson 8 (thin coverage, size on own distribution): abs_move_pct raised from 11 to 12 and the net long grew from +0.4 to +0.7
Lesson 5 (proxy vs. company number): the Tecnoglass peer read-through is kept as a small separate finding (-0.2) with independence stating it overlaps with the company's own aluminum commentary
Lesson 6: bar rests on one estimate feed, so no finding is sized above 1.2 and the revenue mismatch is filed small
